Concentrating before drawing the string will allow you to target distant enemies as easily as those nearby.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 10 |durability = 45 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Phrenic Bow}} Phrenic Bows are a type of [[Bow]] passed down through the [[Sheikah]] tribe. They belong to the [[Sheikah Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all [[Weapon]]s created by the Sheikah.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 170}} By concentrating before pulling the string, the user can enter a first person view that allows them to shoot distant targets as easily as those nearby. Phrenic Bows are most commonly found in [[Treasure Chest]]s in and around [[Lake Hylia]] and [[West Necluda]]. There is also a [[Lizalfos]] that uses a Phrenic Bow at the skull rock base north of [[Sahasra Slope]] in the [[Lanayru Wetlands]]. Finally, they have a chance to appear in Treasure Chests that spawn when the {{SSB}} Series [[Sheik]] [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Sheikah archers, such as [[Impa]]'s bodyguard [[Cado]], utilize Phrenic Bows in [[Kakariko Village]]. They have a wooden construction, and thus they will burn if exposed to a source of [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. As a result of this, however, they do not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]], and they will float if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. They also cannot be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] Rune. Cado is equipped with a Phrenic Bow, which Link can take a picture of with the [[Camera]] [[Rune]] to add its entry to the [[Hyrule Compendium]].
